summary: Pomerium is an identity-aware reverse proxy that intercepts HTTP requests to enforce authentication checks before traffic reaches your internal backend services. It acts as a gatekeeper, requiring users to authenticate via an identity provider before granting access to self-hosted applications on the public internet.
goodFor: Self-hosters who need to expose internal web applications to external users without relying solely on VPN clients.
watchOut: Configuring identity providers and policy rules introduces significant operational complexity compared to standard reverse proxies.
deployNotes: As a Go application distributed via Docker, it typically runs behind a TLS termination proxy and relies on an external identity provider for session management.
